request: AI Core PR3 Docker Gate deployment inventory: never restart 18080 or mutate Docker

bounded_host_request.command:
set -u
printf 'CORE_HOST_HEAD='; git -C /home/admin1/server-core rev-parse HEAD
printf 'CORE_PR3_HEAD='; git -C /home/admin1/projects/ai-core/.worktrees/pr3-verification-20261015 rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo UNKNOWN
printf 'GATE_CONTAINER='; docker inspect -f '{{.State.Status}}|{{.State.ExitCode}}|{{.State.Error}}' ai-core-model-gate 2>/dev/null || echo ABSENT
printf 'GATE_PROCESSES='; pgrep -af '[m]odel_gate.py.*--serve' | wc -l
printf 'GATE_PORTS='; ss -ltn '( sport = :18181 or sport = :18182 or sport = :18183 or sport = :18184 )' | tail -n +2 | wc -l
printf 'DOCKER_SOCKET='; test -S /var/run/docker.sock && echo YES || echo NO
printf 'CGROUP_BUDGET='; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/ai-core.slice/cpu.max /sys/fs/cgroup/ai-core.slice/memory.high /sys/fs/cgroup/ai-core.slice/memory.max 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ','; echo
printf 'API_KEY_SHELL_PRESENT='; test -n "${AI_CORE_API_KEY:-}" && echo YES || echo NO
printf 'GATE_IMAGE='; docker image inspect ai-core-model-gate:local --format '{{.Id}}' 2>/dev/null | cut -c 1-22 || true
printf 'BACKEND_CONTAINERS='; docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}:{{.Status}}' --filter name='^ai-' | tr '\n' ';'; echo
